intro: Searching means finding one item among many. **Big O** tells how the work grows when the list grows.
Read the sections below, then start the quiz.

blocks.text: Look at every item, one by one, until you find it. That is [[O(n)|the work grows in step with the number of items]].
Looking for a sock in a messy drawer: you may have to touch every sock.
On a sorted list, open it in the middle and throw half away. See the [source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Binary_search).

blocks.title: Steps to find one item among 1,024

blocks.text: Use `binary search` when the list is sorted.
